  local found=false

   if surface:IsA('SurfaceGui') and surface.Face==face and surface.Enabled then
    for _,label in ipairs(surface:GetDescendants()) do if label:IsA('TextLabel') and label.Visible and label.TextTransparency<1 and string.find(string.upper(label.Text),string.upper(title),1,true) then found=true end end
   end
  end
  assert(found,'visible sign text missing on '..tostring(face)..': '..title)
 end
 return true
end

local function assertContained(container,object)
 assert(object and object:IsA('GuiObject') and object.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and object.AbsoluteSize.Y>0,'missing rendered rectangle')
 local a,b=container.AbsolutePosition,container.AbsoluteSize local p,s=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 assert(p.X>=a.X-1 and p.Y>=a.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=a.X+b.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=a.Y+b.Y+1,'rendered bounds outside safe host: '..H:JSONEncode({name=object.Name,visible=object.Visible,safe={a.X,a.Y,b.X,b.Y},actual={p.X,p.Y,s.X,s.Y}}))
end
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local node=object while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end node=node.Parent end return true
end
-- BEGIN GENERIC MODAL ASSERTIONS
local function verifyGenericModal(host,safe)
 local p,s,q,t=host.AbsolutePosition,host.AbsoluteSize,safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize
 assert(host.Visible and p.X>=q.X+11 and p.Y>=q.Y+11 and p.X+s.X<=q.X+t.X-11 and p.Y+s.Y<=q.Y+t.Y-11,'generic modal lost the 12px safe margin')
 assert(math.abs(s.X-math.min(677,t.X-24))<=1 and math.abs(s.Y-math.min(408,t.Y-24))<=1,'generic modal does not match bounded desktop dimensions')
 local scroller=assert(host:FindFirstChild('Content'),'generic modal content missing')
 assert(scroller:IsA('ScrollingFrame') and scroller.ScrollingEnabled and scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize==Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,'generic modal content cannot scroll')
 local close=assert(host:FindFirstChild('Close'),'generic close missing')
 assert(close.Visible and close.Active and close.Selectable and math.min(close.AbsoluteSize.X,close.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=44,'generic close is not a 44px action')
 return scroller
end
-- END GENERIC MODAL ASSERTIONS

assert(g.ScreenInsets==Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets and g.SafeAreaCompatibility==Enum.SafeAreaCompatibility.FullscreenExtension,'safe insets incorrect')
a:Invoke('CloseMenus') task.wait(.2) local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD assert(effectivelyVisible(safe),'actual HUD hidden')
for _,name in ipairs({'PowerCard','CoinsCard','WallCard'}) do local card=safe[name] assert(effectivelyVisible(card),'HUD card invisible') assertContained(safe,card) end
local targets=0 for _,tab in ipairs({'Tasks','Settings'}) do a:Invoke('OpenTab',tab) task.wait(.3) local host=tab=='Settings' and g.SettingsWindow or g.GameMenu assert(effectivelyVisible(host),'modal not visible') assertContained(safe,host)

 if tab=='Tasks' and g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile')=='Desktop' then

  assert(maxY>0,'Tasks fixture should expose actual vertical scrolling')

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local function combatNumber(value)
 value=tonumber(value) or 0
 for _,unit in ipairs({{1e12,'T'},{1e9,'B'},{1e6,'M'},{1e3,'K'}}) do if math.abs(value)>=unit[1] then return string.format('%.1f%s',value/unit[1],unit[2]) end end
 return tostring(math.floor(value+.5))
end
local function verifyCombatPresentation(actual,expected)
 assert(actual.kind==expected.kind and actual.target==expected.target and actual.canonical==expected.canonical,'HUD target/canonical identity disagrees with actual target')
 assert(actual.wallVisible==(expected.kind=='Wall') and actual.bossVisible==(expected.kind=='Boss'),'wall/boss presentation is not exclusive')
 assert(actual.title==expected.title,'HUD display title/phase/weak-point guidance incorrect')
 assert(math.abs(actual.fill-expected.fill)<.001,'HUD fill disagrees with actual HP')
 assert(actual.detail:find(expected.hpText,1,true)==1,'HUD HP numbers disagree with actual target')
 assert(actual.outlineCount==1,'owned target outline duplicated or missing')
 if expected.kind=='Wall' then
  assert(actual.hits==expected.hits and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  ~'..combatNumber(expected.hits)..' hits','HUD hit estimate disagrees with authoritative effective power')
  assert(actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget==expected.target,'outline lost actual live target')
 else
  assert(not actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget=='','boss retains stale wall outline')
  if expected.countdown then
   local seconds=tonumber(actual.detail:match('  |  SHOCKWAVE (%d+)s$'))
   assert(seconds and seconds>=0 and math.abs(seconds-expected.countdown)<=1 and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  SHOCKWAVE '..seconds..'s','HUD countdown disagrees with replicated attack deadline')
  else assert(actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  TARGET RED CORES','idle boss weak-point guidance incorrect') end
 end
 assert(actual.distance<= (expected.kind=='Wall' and 24 or 55),'target outside presentation range')
 assert(actual.textFits and actual.safeBounds,'actual HUD text/bounds clipped')
 return true
end
local function replicatedPower(p,G)
 local function read(name,fallback) local value=p.RPGStats:FindFirstChild(name) or p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) return value and value.Value or fallback end
 return G.EffectivePower(read('Power',0),read('FistMultiplier',1),read('PetMultiplier',0),read('Rebirths',0),read('FistMastery',1),read('HonorPowerBonus',0))
end
local function observeCombatHUD(g,p,target,kind)
 local frame=kind=='Wall' and g.TargetWallHUD or g.BossHUD
 local title=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetTitle or frame.BossTitle
 local detail=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetDetail or frame.BossSubtitle
 local track=kind=='Wall' and frame.HealthTrack or frame.BossHealthTrack
 local fill=kind=='Wall' and track.HealthFill or track.BossHealthFill
 local outline,count=nil,0
 for _,item in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if item.Name=='Local Target Highlight' and item:IsA('Highlight') then outline=item count+=1 end end
 local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local a,s=safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize local b,z=frame.AbsolutePosition,frame.AbsoluteSize
 return {kind=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind'),target=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget'),canonical=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDCanonicalTarget'),hits=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDHitEstimate'),wallVisible=g.TargetWallHUD.Visible,bossVisible=g.BossHUD.Visible,title=title.Text,detail=detail.Text,fill=fill.Size.X.Scale,outlineCount=count,outlineEnabled=outline and outline.Enabled==true,outlineTarget=outline and outline.Adornee and outline.Adornee.Name or '',distance=(target.Position-p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude,textFits=title.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and detail.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and title.TextBounds.X<=title.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and title.TextBounds.Y<=title.AbsoluteSize.Y+1 and detail.TextBounds.X<=detail.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and detail.TextBounds.Y<=detail.AbsoluteSize.Y+1,safeBounds=z.X>0 and z.Y>0 and b.X>=a.X-1 and b.Y>=a.Y-1 and b.X+z.X<=a.X+s.X+1 and b.Y+z.Y<=a.Y+s.Y+1}
end
local function awaitCombatTarget(g,kind,name)
 g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('CloseMenus')
 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 repeat task.wait(.05) until (g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name) or os.clock()>deadline
 assert(g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name,'bounded HUD target observation timed out')
end

local b=assert(workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']:FindFirstChild('DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02'),'fixture block missing')
awaitCombatTarget(g,'Wall',b.Name)
local def=assert(G.Walls[b:GetAttribute('MaterialTier')]) local hp,maxHP=b:GetAttribute('HP'),b:GetAttribute('MaxHP')
assert(not b:GetAttribute('Broken') and b.CanQuery and b.Transparency<1 and hp>0 and maxHP>0,'target is not actual live geometry')
assert(hp<maxHP,'partial damage fixture no longer present')
local level=p.leaderstats.WallLevel.Value assert(level>=b:GetAttribute('RequiredLevel'),'hit estimate fixture below level gate')
local damage=replicatedPower(p,G) if (p:GetAttribute('DamageBoostExpiresAt') or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then damage*=2 end assert(damage>0,'fixture has no effective power')
local expected={kind='Wall',target=b.Name,canonical=def.name,title=string.upper(def.displayName or def.name),fill=hp/maxHP,hpText='HP '..combatNumber(hp)..'/'..combatNumber(maxHP),hits=math.ceil(hp/damage)}
local actual=observeCombatHUD(g,p,b,'Wall') verifyCombatPresentation(actual,expected)
assert(not g.ContextTarget.Visible,'generic context overlaps wall target')

return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,title=actual.title,canonical=actual.canonical,detail=actual.detail,actualFill=actual.fill,expectedFill=expected.fill,hits=actual.hits,target=actual.target})

 assert(e and e.token==view.token,'reward observer identity lost')
 local rewards,levels,soundEvents=0,0,0
 for _,v in ipairs(e.events or {}) do
  if v.type=='Reward' or v.type=='LevelUp' or v.type=='DepthRecord' or v.type=='RankChange' or v.type=='TierEntry' or v.type=='QuestComplete' then soundEvents+=1 end
  if v.type=='Reward' and v.wallBreak then
   rewards+=1 assert(v.target==s.target and v.coins==s.coins and v.score==s.score and v.depth==s.newDepth,'real reward differs from server result')
  elseif v.type=='LevelUp' then levels+=1 assert(v.target==tostring(s.level),'level event identity incorrect') end
 end
 assert(rewards==1 and levels==s.levelEvents,'missing or duplicate actual reward/level event')
 assert(e.coinsCreated==7 and e.coinSounds==1 and e.rewardSounds>=1 and e.rewardSounds<=soundEvents and view.burstDelta==7,'actual reward visual/sound consumer missing or duplicated')
 assert(view.coins==s.newCoins and view.depth==s.newDepth and view.xp==s.xp and view.level==s.level,'replicated reward differs from authoritative result')
 assert(view.hudCoins==view.expectedCoins and view.hudDepth==view.expectedDepth and view.hudVisible and view.hudFits,'visible reward HUD disagrees with replicated values')
 assert(view.pops==0 and view.toasts<=3 and view.rewardNoticeCount==0 and view.nonoverlap and view.layout,'reward duplicated or notice layout invalid')
 return true
end
local function numberText(value)
 for _,u in ipairs({{1e12,'T'},{1e9,'B'},{1e6,'M'},{1e3,'K'}}) do if value>=u[1] then return string.format('%.1f%s',value/u[1],u[2]) end end return tostring(math.floor(value+.5))
end
local function visible(item) local node=item while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end if node:IsA('ScreenGui') and not node.Enabled then return false end node=node.Parent end return true end
local deadline=os.clock()+1 local e,s
repeat task.wait(.03) e=H:JSONDecode(g:GetAttribute('SmashRewardEvidence') or '{}') s=H:JSONDecode(p:GetAttribute('SmashRewardServerEvidence') or '{}') until s.newCoins and p.leaderstats.Coins.Value==s.newCoins and (e.coinsCreated or 0)==7 and g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.CoinsCard.CoinsValue.Text==numberText(s.newCoins) and g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.WallCard.DepthValue.Text==numberText(s.newDepth) or os.clock()>=deadline
local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local coins=safe.CoinsCard.CoinsValue local depth=safe.WallCard.DepthValue
local view={token=g:GetAttribute('SmashRewardObserverToken'),coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,depth=p.leaderstats.Depth.Value,xp=p.leaderstats.WallXP.Value,level=p.leaderstats.WallLevel.Value,hudCoins=coins.Text,hudDepth=depth.Text,expectedCoins=numberText(s.newCoins or -1),expectedDepth=numberText(s.newDepth or -1),hudVisible=visible(coins) and visible(depth),hudFits=true,pops=0,toasts=0,rewardNoticeCount=0,nonoverlap=true,layout=g.RewardPops:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UIListLayout')~=nil and g.Toasts:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UIListLayout')~=nil,burstDelta=(g:GetAttribute('CoinBurstTotal') or 0)-(e.burstBefore or 0)}
for _,label in ipairs({coins,depth}) do local a,z=label.AbsolutePosition,label.AbsoluteSize local b,w=safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize if z.X<=0 or z.Y<=0 or label.TextBounds.X>z.X+1 or label.TextBounds.Y>z.Y+1 or a.X<b.X-1 or a.Y<b.Y-1 or a.X+z.X>b.X+w.X+1 or a.Y+z.Y>b.Y+w.Y+1 then view.hudFits=false end end
local rects={}
for _,holder in ipairs({g.RewardPops,g.Toasts}) do for _,item in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA('TextLabel') then
 if holder==g.RewardPops then view.pops+=1 else view.toasts+=1 end
 if item.Text:find('WALL BREAK!',1,true) or item.Text:find('WALL LEVEL ',1,true) then view.rewardNoticeCount+=1 end
 if visible(item) and item.TextTransparency<1 then table.insert(rects,{x=item.AbsolutePosition.X,y=item.AbsolutePosition.Y,w=item.AbsoluteSize.X,h=item.AbsoluteSize.Y}) end
end end end
for i=1,#rects do for j=i+1,#rects do local a,b=rects[i],rects[j] if a.x<b.x+b.w and a.x+a.w>b.x and a.y<b.y+b.h and a.y+a.h>b.y then view.nonoverlap=false end end end

verifyRewardEvidence(e,s,view)

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local function combatNumber(value)
 value=tonumber(value) or 0
 for _,unit in ipairs({{1e12,'T'},{1e9,'B'},{1e6,'M'},{1e3,'K'}}) do if math.abs(value)>=unit[1] then return string.format('%.1f%s',value/unit[1],unit[2]) end end
 return tostring(math.floor(value+.5))
end
local function verifyCombatPresentation(actual,expected)
 assert(actual.kind==expected.kind and actual.target==expected.target and actual.canonical==expected.canonical,'HUD target/canonical identity disagrees with actual target')
 assert(actual.wallVisible==(expected.kind=='Wall') and actual.bossVisible==(expected.kind=='Boss'),'wall/boss presentation is not exclusive')
 assert(actual.title==expected.title,'HUD display title/phase/weak-point guidance incorrect')
 assert(math.abs(actual.fill-expected.fill)<.001,'HUD fill disagrees with actual HP')
 assert(actual.detail:find(expected.hpText,1,true)==1,'HUD HP numbers disagree with actual target')
 assert(actual.outlineCount==1,'owned target outline duplicated or missing')
 if expected.kind=='Wall' then
  assert(actual.hits==expected.hits and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  ~'..combatNumber(expected.hits)..' hits','HUD hit estimate disagrees with authoritative effective power')
  assert(actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget==expected.target,'outline lost actual live target')
 else
  assert(not actual.outlineEnabled and actual.outlineTarget=='','boss retains stale wall outline')
  if expected.countdown then
   local seconds=tonumber(actual.detail:match('  |  SHOCKWAVE (%d+)s$'))
   assert(seconds and seconds>=0 and math.abs(seconds-expected.countdown)<=1 and actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  SHOCKWAVE '..seconds..'s','HUD countdown disagrees with replicated attack deadline')
  else assert(actual.detail==expected.hpText..'  |  TARGET RED CORES','idle boss weak-point guidance incorrect') end
 end
 assert(actual.distance<= (expected.kind=='Wall' and 24 or 55),'target outside presentation range')
 assert(actual.textFits and actual.safeBounds,'actual HUD text/bounds clipped')
 return true
end
local function observeCombatHUD(g,p,target,kind)
 local frame=kind=='Wall' and g.TargetWallHUD or g.BossHUD
 local title=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetTitle or frame.BossTitle
 local detail=kind=='Wall' and frame.TargetDetail or frame.BossSubtitle
 local track=kind=='Wall' and frame.HealthTrack or frame.BossHealthTrack
 local fill=kind=='Wall' and track.HealthFill or track.BossHealthFill
 local outline,count=nil,0
 for _,item in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if item.Name=='Local Target Highlight' and item:IsA('Highlight') then outline=item count+=1 end end
 local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local a,s=safe.AbsolutePosition,safe.AbsoluteSize local b,z=frame.AbsolutePosition,frame.AbsoluteSize
 return {kind=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind'),target=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget'),canonical=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDCanonicalTarget'),hits=g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDHitEstimate'),wallVisible=g.TargetWallHUD.Visible,bossVisible=g.BossHUD.Visible,title=title.Text,detail=detail.Text,fill=fill.Size.X.Scale,outlineCount=count,outlineEnabled=outline and outline.Enabled==true,outlineTarget=outline and outline.Adornee and outline.Adornee.Name or '',distance=(target.Position-p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude,textFits=title.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and detail.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and title.TextBounds.X<=title.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and title.TextBounds.Y<=title.AbsoluteSize.Y+1 and detail.TextBounds.X<=detail.AbsoluteSize.X+1 and detail.TextBounds.Y<=detail.AbsoluteSize.Y+1,safeBounds=z.X>0 and z.Y>0 and b.X>=a.X-1 and b.Y>=a.Y-1 and b.X+z.X<=a.X+s.X+1 and b.Y+z.Y<=a.Y+s.Y+1}
end
local function awaitCombatTarget(g,kind,name)
 g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('CloseMenus')
 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 repeat task.wait(.05) until (g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name) or os.clock()>deadline
 assert(g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDKind')==kind and g:GetAttribute('CombatHUDTarget')==name,'bounded HUD target observation timed out')
end

local b=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Walls['Titan Server Wall'] awaitCombatTarget(g,'Boss',b.Name)
-- Replication may publish NextAttackAt before the 0.15s HUD scan consumes it.
local deadline=os.clock()+4 local nextAt,now,seconds
repeat
 nextAt=b:GetAttribute('NextAttackAt') or 0 now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 seconds=tonumber(g.BossHUD.BossSubtitle.Text:match('SHOCKWAVE (%d+)s'))
 if nextAt>now+.5 and seconds and math.abs(seconds-math.ceil(nextAt-now))<=1 then break end
 task.wait(.03)
until os.clock()>deadline
assert(nextAt>now+.5 and seconds and math.abs(seconds-math.ceil(nextAt-now))<=1,'bounded countdown presentation did not consume replicated deadline: '..g.BossHUD.BossSubtitle.Text)
local hp,maxHP=b:GetAttribute('HP'),b:GetAttribute('MaxHP') local phase=b:GetAttribute('BossPhase') local nextAt=b:GetAttribute('NextAttackAt')
assert(phase==2 and not b:GetAttribute('Broken') and hp>0 and maxHP>0,'actual encounter phase changed')
assert(nextAt>0 and hp<maxHP,'phase-two damage/countdown missing')
local expected={kind='Boss',target=b.Name,canonical=b.Name,title=('TITAN P%d  |  WEAK x1.5'):format(phase),fill=hp/maxHP,hpText='HP '..combatNumber(hp)..'/'..combatNumber(maxHP),countdown=nextAt>0 and math.max(0,math.ceil(nextAt-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())) or nil}
local actual=observeCombatHUD(g,p,b,'Boss') verifyCombatPresentation(actual,expected)
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,title=actual.title,subtitle=actual.detail,phase=phase,actualFill=actual.fill,expectedFill=expected.fill,actualBoundsSafe=actual.safeBounds})
